scope_exclusions.finding: Exclude under original-publisher lineage scope: Databricks fine-tuned an EleutherAI Pythia checkpoint. Already known to root.

groups.review: Seven models, date and nominal counts verified against dated publisher release; 2048 context in pinned model-card architecture table.

Ten models verified against three dated publisher launch articles and official Foundry context table. 8K base license CC-BY-SA-3.0 is intentional. Earlier 7B sizes use 6.7B from original launch; later 8K uses publisher nominal 7B.

Six models verified against publisher launch/changelog and individual pinned cards/configs. April 19/20 primary-source discrepancy is already disclosed. v2 exact counts match cards, so they should not be overwritten by slightly different safetensors metadata.

18 models verified against publisher changelog and pinned model cards/configs. April 3 is the retrained release, not the original v0; November 2 is only 14M/31M. Exact totals include embeddings and match publisher tables; HF safetensors totals differ and are not a reason to replace documented counts.
Six records verified against May 5 and June 6 publisher releases and individual pinned cards. 7B v1 is distinct from May preview checkpoint, as notes state.
Three Falcon records verified against dated TII releases and coauthored Falcon launch documentation. May 25 Falcon40B is public weights release; March unveiling is not substituted.

limits: This is a review of the 51 proposed records, not evidence that all 2023 releases have been found.
Freshly opened primary announcements and changelogs were compared with the fetched pinned model-card/config evidence in this directory. No weights were downloaded.
